import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int evenCount = 0, oddCount = 0;
    static List<Integer> cutValues = new ArrayList<>();

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int budget = sc.nextInt();
        int[] arr = new int[n];
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            arr[i] = sc.nextInt();
            if (arr[i] % 2 == 0) evenCount++;
            else oddCount++;
        }
        
        if (evenCount != oddCount) {
            System.out.println(0);
        } else {
            computeCuts(arr);
            Collections.sort(cutValues);
            int totalCost = 0;
            int cutsCount = 0;
            for (int cut : cutValues) {
                if (totalCost + cut <= budget) {
                    totalCost += cut;
                    cutsCount++;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
            System.out.println(cutsCount);
        }
    }
    
    public static void computeCuts(int[] arr) {
        int evens = 0, odds = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length - 1; i++) {
            if (arr[i] % 2 == 0) evens++;
            else odds++;
            if (evens == odds) {
                cutValues.add(Math.abs(arr[i + 1] - arr[i]));
            }
        }
    }
}
